description: Run Paperpal manuscript checks and review results for Grammar, Plagiarism, Reference Checks, and Journal Fit.

interface.longDescription:
Paperpal for ChatGPT runs checks that catch issues before you submit: Grammar, Plagiarism, Reference Checks, and Journal Fit. Scan your document for grammar issues and get a deep polish, with results linking back to Paperpal for full review and a tracked-changes download. Run a plagiarism check to see where your document stands, backed by a full report. Check your references and citations across 9 categories, including retractions, hallucinations, excessive self-citation, and citation-reference mismatches. Check journal fit to see if your manuscript meets common pre-submission requirements before you send it in. Results link back to Paperpal for deeper review, full reports, and further manuscript enhancements.

Get started with prompts like:
'Paperpal, please check my references and citations.'
'Paperpal, does my manuscript have language errors?'

positive.prompt: @Paperpal, run all checks on my document.
positive.tools_triggered: show_document_upload → upload_document → start_document_checks → get_check_run_status (on progress update).
positive.expected_behavior:
User will get a nudge to upload a document and choose checks to run. Based on which checks the user picks, the relevant results will be shown. The MCP covers the following 4 Paperpal Checks.
Grammar, Plagiarism, Reference Checks, and Journal Fit

positive.prompt: @Paperpal, are my citations and references okay?
positive.expected_behavior: User will get a nudge to upload a document and run Reference Checks. The Reference Check result will be shown once ready and the user can view the full report on Paperpal (note that Reference Checks is available with paid Paperpal plans only).

positive.prompt: @Paperpal, is there any similarity in my document?
positive.expected_behavior: User will get a nudge to upload a document and run the Plagiarism Check. The check result will be shown once ready and the user can view the report on Paperpal.

publication.release_notes:
Run Paperpal's academic checks directly in ChatGPT. Upload your manuscript and ask in plain language.

Grammar: Get academic language edits. Review them one by one or download a tracked-changes file.

Plagiarism: Check your manuscript for similarity and download a full report.

Reference Checks: Check your references and citations across nine checks, including retractions, relevance, self-citation, journal quality, and DOI validity, and download a full report.

Journal Fit: Check your manuscript against 30+ common journal requirements and see how ready it is for submission.
